P11.rationale: The right panel shows three labeled outcome rows with short descriptor tags (e.g., '100% automatisiert'), but these are text-based callouts rather than true data visualisations with quantified before/after metrics, charts, or cost-math calculations.

P13.rationale: The left column uses a warm off-white/cream background while the right panel uses a dark teal field, and a subtle wave/landscape silhouette graphic appears at the bottom of the left column, providing atmospheric texture beyond flat blankness.
